title: Apply for a licence to process, pack and store seafood
summary: Find out how to apply for a licence from the NSW Food Authority if your business processes, packs, or stores seafood.
intro:
You must hold a licence with the NSW Food Authority if your business:

You can apply and pay for the licence online.

To apply for 5 or more premises, you need to submit a printed application form.

Note: You must not start business operations until you have your licence.
who_can_apply: Your business processes, packs, or stores seafood.
what_you_need: ASIC company statement showing the director names (if applicable)
Confirmation of your registered business name (if applicable)
Details of the business activities, location and food handlers
Vessel and beach hauling details (if applicable)
Wild shellfish collection, processing and storage details (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Application for a licence for a food business – seafood (excluding shellfish cultivation or harvest) – PDF.
Submit your application with payment by post or email, to the details on the form.

more_info.text: To change or cancel a licence, contact the Food Authority Licensing Unit on (02) 6552 3000.
If you transport seafood, you need to apply for a licence to operate a food business.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to process, pack, or store seafood?
faqs.a: Yes, you must hold a licence with the NSW Food Authority if your business processes, packs, or stores seafood.

faqs.q: When can I start my business operations?
faqs.a: You must not start business operations until you have your licence.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You can apply and pay for the licence online. If you are applying for 5 or more premises, you need to submit a printed application form.
